Topics · One God, one message

Who actually split the religions, and why?

Knowledge came first, then the split. Two words, four times, give the cause: sad, shared, and with a way back.

Part 1 of 3

﴿شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ١٣ وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ١٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him]. And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word[1413] that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.

Translator's notes

[1413] Decree. See footnote to 10:19.

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:13-14

Translation

for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

Original · Ancient Greek

ἔτι γὰρ σαρκικοί ἐστε. ὅπου γὰρ ἐν ὑμῖν ζῆλος καὶ ἔρις, οὐχὶ σαρκικοί ἐστε καὶ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖτε;

1 Corinthians · 3:3

World English Bible

Anyone looking for the origin of division has two familiar explanations: God wanted it, or people did not know better. These verses give a third sequence. Everyone was given one command: do not split. Then the second verse says they split after knowledge came to them. Notice the word "after". If ignorance were the cause, division would have come before knowledge. The order was clear, the knowledge was present, and the split came from people after that.

A question for you

When a group that knows it was told not to split splits anyway, what must have happened?

If you saySomething stronger than knowledge won
ThenThe next part gives that thing its name.
If you sayThey understood it differently
ThenThat does happen honestly, and it has its place. The verse names another cause as well; see whether it explains what is left.
If you sayThere was never one order
ThenA position you can test by comparing what the messengers carried.

﴿إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ﴾

Proverbs · 13:10

World English Bible

﴿كَانَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ وَأَنزَلَ مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فِيمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ فِيهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ فَهَدَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Mankind was [of] one religion [before their deviation]; then Allāh sent the prophets as bringers of good tidings and warners and sent down with them the Scripture in truth to judge between the people concerning that in which they differed. And none differed over it [i.e., the Scripture] except those who were given it - after the clear proofs came to them - out of jealous animosity among themselves. And Allāh guided those who believed to the truth concerning that over which they had differed, by His permission. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:213

Translation

He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

Original · Ancient Greek

ἐποίησέν τε ἐξ ἑνὸς πᾶν ἔθνος ἀνθρώπων κατοικεῖν ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τῆς γῆς, ὁρίσας προστεταγμένους καιροὺς καὶ τὰς ὁροθεσίας τῆς κατοικίας αὐτῶν,

Acts · 17:26

World English Bible

Now the cause. These three verses, with the one before, repeat two words: rivalry among them. It means seeking to rise over another. Check it against the world. If division came from ignorance it would fade as knowledge grew. Yet it can persist even among the learned of many traditions. Rivalry survives knowledge. So rivalry explains what ignorance cannot. Notice too the word "among": this happened inside, between brothers, not between strangers.

A question for you

Why, do you think, do those closest to each other fight harder than strangers do?

If you sayThey compete for the same thing
ThenThat explains two facts at once: why the religions resemble each other and why they fight. One source, then rivalry over it.
If you sayA wound from someone close goes deeper
ThenYes, and that is why this story is sad. It is not a story of enemies. It is a story of brothers.
If you sayI doubt rivalry explains everything
ThenIt does not explain everything. What remains is what feeds it, and the next stage looks at that.

﴿إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ٩٢ وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ٩٣﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed this, your religion, is one religion,[903] and I am your Lord, so worship Me. And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves,[904] [but] all to Us will return.

Translator's notes

[903] i.e., a collective way of life or course of conduct followed by a community.

[904] Becoming sects and denominations.

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:92-93

Translation

Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

Original · Hebrew

הֲל֨וֹא אָ֤ב אֶחָד֙ לְכֻלָּ֔נוּ הֲל֛וֹא אֵ֥ל אֶֽחָ֖ד בְּרָאָ֑נוּ מַדּ֗וּעַ נִבְגַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּאָחִ֔יו לְחַלֵּ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית אֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃

Malachi · 2:10

World English Bible

If people made the division, people can turn back from it. Here two facts stand together: your nation is one, your Lord is one, and then: they cut their affair to pieces among them. The last words are: all are returning to Us. So division is not the final word, and the return belongs to all. This is an invitation, no promise of a united world: the Quran itself says people will go on differing (11:118-119). But the road is open to each person.
